name: Confidence Calibration
purpose: Compare NØX confidence with observed accuracy and progressively calibrate confidence without inventing outcomes.
principle: Confidence must be learned from repeated observed outcomes, not assumed from internal scores.

calibration_model.confidence_measurement: Internal confidence attached to an explicit prediction.
calibration_model.observed_accuracy: Measured correctness only when a real outcome is explicitly available.
calibration_model.calibration_error: Absolute difference between mean predicted confidence and observed accuracy.
calibration_model.missing_outcomes_rule: Missing outcomes are excluded from calibration and never counted as failures.
calibration_model.minimum_evidence_rule: No strong calibration claim is permitted without repeated comparable observations.

confidence_policy.rule: Do not increase autonomous confidence solely because internal confidence is high.

decision_policy: Do not treat missing outcomes as incorrect predictions.
Do not treat predictions without outcomes as calibration evidence.
Do not claim calibration when there are no evaluated outcomes.
Use repeated comparable outcomes before making strong calibration adjustments.
Reduce confidence when observed accuracy is below predicted confidence.
Do not increase confidence merely because internal scores are high.
Keep calibration separate from measurement reliability.
Keep empirical accuracy separate from structural consistency.
Use ACT38 decision ceilings as an independent upper bound.
A calibration factor does not grant execution permission.
lessons: Confidence cannot be calibrated without outcomes.
A prediction can be confidently made and still remain empirically untested.
Calibration requires repeated comparison between predicted confidence and actual results.
Missing evidence is not evidence of failure.
Confidence calibration is itself a learned capability.

repair_queue.action: Record actual outcomes for predictions in a canonical structured field so future calibration can evaluate them.
Preserve prediction confidence and outcome fields unchanged across downstream ACTs.

autonomy_rule.rule: ACT39 may calibrate confidence from real outcomes, but cannot execute actions, spend funds or make payments.

next_cognitive_step: ACT40 should learn how to select actions using calibrated confidence, evidence quality and expected value while preserving uncertainty and reversibility.
